easyPrerequisites: Loot and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Loot, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
